facts.fact: The current Sukanya Samriddhi rate is 8.2% per annum, compounded yearly (India Post savings page, last updated 19.10.2026)
facts.quote: Sukanya Samriddhi Account (SSA) Rate of Interest: 8.2% per annum calculated on yearly basis, Yearly compounded.

facts.fact: The NSI table shows Sukanya Samriddhi at 8.2% from 01.01.2024 to 30.09.2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026)
Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: DEA's OM of 30.09.2026 keeps small-savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so Sukanya Samriddhi stays at 8.2%
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter
facts.note: DEA OM F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026, read by OCR of the scanned PDF. 8.2% is derived: the OM gives no rates; the Q2 rate of 8.2% is from NSI (fact 2).

summary: SSA 8.2% (India Post, NSI to 30.09.2026) and DEA OM 30.09.2026 keeping Q3 rates unchanged (OCR of R.pdf) confirmed.
